what: The section is pinned, and once the cover sentence lifts away, scattered colored dots sprout one by one, then gather into their set places turning ink color, and lines between the dots are drawn in turn to form a constellation — over 2600px of scrolling

options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot (child) — data-from="x,y" Scatter destination, data-to="x,y" Gathering spot (0–1 ratio), and the --c in style is the starting color (default accent color)
options.edges: Number pairs of points to connect "0-1,1-5,…" — If given, a line is created and drawn
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: Panel that starts covering then lifts away (child)
options.[data-fx-part=hint]: Guide text that will disappear midway (child)

use: …

from.where: about.html .ab-stars (constellation — fourteen colored dots gather and join with lines)
